questions.question: What happened after Aaron offered the first sacrifices?
options: Rain fell and put out the altar fire
Fire from the LORD consumed the offering
A cloud filled the tent and hid the altar
The earth shook and split open the ground
questions.answer: Fire from the LORD consumed the offering

questions.question: How did the people respond when the glory of the LORD appeared?
options: They turned and fled in terror

questions.question: The glory of the LORD appeared to all the people.
_____ came out from before the LORD and consumed the burnt offering on the altar.
